text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mayano said I'm still a stupid kid 'cause I
don't
know anything about love!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But that's not true! I know a thing or two
about it,
I swear!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, your chest gets all tight and your
heart
goes crazy, right? That's just like
what happens
when I watch a super
amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What're you laughing at?! If I'm
wrong, just
tell me!
